doc: True controls: no detector may flag them (plan 31.10 §5.2). Seeded by WP-0; the package appends its own.

controls.why: Qxf7# mates: a fork fact that is a mate is kept
Nc7+ forks the king e8 and the rook a8 (prod 23.10, tests/unit/test_puzzle_solution_2026_10_23 FORK): kept
controls.source: design-detect §2 / triage reports; P8: the seeded FEN had the black queen on d8 guarding c7, see recaptured-fork-dropped

controls.why: 8...Qxd5 takes the queen back (−6): the fork fact must go
the knight f6 attacked by e5 has safe squares (d5, e4, g8)
3.Nxc7+ Qxc7: the queen d8 takes the knight back (a knight for a pawn) — not a fork to tell
controls.source: P8 (the FEN WP-0 seeded for royal-fork-kept)

controls.why: Legal's mate: 6.Bxf7+ Ke7 7.Nd5# mates; Nxf7 (queen and rook) is a fork beside a mate — the mate is told, not the fork
Qxg7# mates at once; Rd7 (queen and knight) is not the point
e5 is attacked once (Nc6) and defended once (Nf3): 3...Qe7 adds a second attacker and the exchange then wins it (st2#2)
after 4.exf6 Black takes the pawn back with gxf6 or Qxf6 (st2#4: «белые забирают фигуру бесплатно»)
after 6.exd8=R+ Black can take the checker with Kxd8 or Nxd8, or play Ke7; no block (st2#8)
